name: Mage-VL-Cowork 4B

lineage.how_derived: five-stage specialize-then-unify curriculum: GUI midtraining, GUI agent SFT, coding and terminal SFT, hybrid CUA SFT, online hybrid RL (GRPO)

purpose: One compact 4B policy that knows when to click and when to code: screenshot-grounded GUI interaction (computer_use) and persistent code/terminal execution (bash) in a single vision-language policy without an external orchestrator; aimed at on-device computer-use agents (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read: Apache License 2.0 text (only the header was read; no extra terms seen).

architecture.kind: dense vision-language (llava_onevision2 type): Mage-ViT (16x16 patch grid, 3D RoPE) + Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
architecture.why_this_design: Card: hybrid computer use needs both channels in one policy because pixels-only agents spend thousands of tokens per screenshot and re-deriving file edits by clicking discards the fastest, most verifiable channel; working memory is an asymmetric window of the 3 most recent screenshots, 4 full responses and folded action history; active context 32,768 tokens.

engine_support.notes: ggml-org published GGUF conversions on 2026-11-07, so llama.cpp supports the architecture.

strengths: fits any class at about 3 GB quantized
routes between GUI and shell per turn; online RL cut output tokens per task by 25% while raising accuracy by 10 points (card)
weaknesses: a computer-use policy, not a repository coding model; no SWE-bench or Terminal-Bench numbers
benchmarks are the vendor's own harness
soft.maturity: Microsoft Mage-VL family; 5.5k downloads of the main repo, community GGUFs within a week

tona_fit.reason: Interesting small computer-use agent (Apache-2.0 text verified), not a coding-agent model; Tona's workers are repository coding agents, so it matters only if a GUI-automation role is added.
blockers: needs a computer-use harness (screenshots, bash tool)
